title: Cosmic Skull Nebula
description: A large iridescent skull with glowing star-filled eye sockets and teeth sits at the center of swirling golden and purple cosmic rings. Above it floats a vibrant spherical galaxy filled with stars and nebulae, while colorful paint drips cascade from the top edge against a starry background.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a large iridescent purple and teal skull with glowing starfield eyes and teeth, positioned at the center of swirling golden rings and vortex patterns. A luminous spherical galaxy filled with colorful stars and nebulae floats in the upper right. Vibrant paint drips in pink, blue, yellow, and green fall from the top edge. Black ink splatter textures and small scarab beetle details on a white and purple gradient background.
